description: T3: Sequential (state-based) Trojan in 8-bit ALU. Uses a 3-stage finite state machine that must observe a specific sequence of operations to trigger.
taxonomy: Digital, sequentially triggered, state-based Hardware Trojan

trigger.condition: 3-cycle sequence: 1) OP=010 (AND) with A==B; 2) OP=100 (XOR) with A==~B; 3) OP=000 (ADD) with A[7]==1
trigger.readable: State machine transitions 00 -> 01 -> 10 -> 11 upon seeing the sequence. Latches at 11.
trigger.note: Requires identifying sequential elements (FFs) and clock connectivity.

payload.action: Invert zero and carry flags permanently once triggered.
payload.note: Payload is latched on until reset.

structural_hints.expected_trigger_structure: State machine with 2 FFs (e.g., FDRE/FDCE). Combinational logic feeding D-inputs based on current state and ALU inputs.
structural_hints.expected_payload_structure: XOR gates on the carry and zero output paths, driven by the state==11 signal.
